_doc: AUTHORED map readings for T-2495. Crop pixels below are relative to the north detail rectangle, not full-sheet coordinates. The original detailed tile is preserved. Wrong-date Sanborn core and Talbot 1904 context disagree at their seams; the first 160 m blends that disagreement as reconstructed geometry.
control_note: Affine fit against the surviving avenue crossings in prairie_1904_control.json. Pixel picking and the small-scale map justify an approximately 40 m working uncertainty beyond the controls; fitted residuals alone do not measure that uncertainty.
shore_note: Mainland water edge, not the outer water hachures or detached breakwaters. Includes the Twelfth Street projection, Sixteenth Street inlet and 26th–28th Street railroad projection. Grant Park being filled up is represented at the map’s drawn mainland boundary; its internal completion is unresolved. The small re-entrant at Sixteenth is simplified where the detailed tile takes over.

south_continuation.note: Southeast pixels are full-sheet coordinates. Registration ties the rail at the north sheet’s southern join to the southeast sheet and carries the north fit’s scale and axes. The continuation and small shore recesses are approximate, reconstructed; no survey precision claimed.

track_note: Carry every through track that actually meets each detailed-tile edge; preserve its identity and blend its spacing to a 4.3 m corridor fan. Talbot draws a railway symbol, not individual tracks; count, spacing and intermediate curves are reconstructed. No new station or switch is asserted.
